reuse.why: Extracts createRecurSchedule shared with getUpcomingDates and calls getDateWithSkippedWeekend, but the per-occurrence weekend decision (daily skip vs shift) is rewritten rather than shared with getUpcomingDates.

duplication.why: The `skipWeekend` + `isDaily` skip-or-shift branch and the captureBreadcrumb try/catch repeat getUpcomingDates' logic in a different shape.

placement.why: Correctly in server/schedules/app.ts and registered with the other handlers, though placed after the services rather than next to getUpcomingDates.

scope.why: Only the new handler, a tiny extraction it needs, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Readable and commented, with the schedule construction shared, but the weekend rule now has to be kept in sync in two handlers.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses recurConfigToRSchedule (via createRecurSchedule) and getDateWithSkippedWeekend; no existing occurrence-adjustment abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: getDatesInRange in server/schedules/app.ts restates getUpcomingDates' daily-skip/else-shift branching as nested ifs with `continue` instead of extracting a shared per-occurrence adjustment.
